stories.title: Reliance posts a record Rs 29,550 crore quarterly profit
stories.summary: Reliance Industries reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue in July to September, up 27.8% to Rs 3,62,268 crore, and profit up 33.8% to Rs 29,550 crore. EBITDA hit a record Rs 62,409 crore. First-half profit crossed Rs 50,000 crore.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty snap a two-month losing streak in October
stories.summary: The Nifty rose 1.9% and the Sensex 2.7% in October, ending two months of losses on IT strength, resilient earnings and hopes of a capital gains tax cut. Rising crude limited gains. The Nifty closed Friday at 23,053.1 and the Sensex at 74,459.53.

stories.title: Smallcaps jump 4% in the week as pharma leads
stories.summary: Indian equities closed higher in the week ended 30 October, with the Nifty Pharma and Nifty Media indices up 7.1% and 4.3%. Sentiment was helped by the Jio Platforms listing, while Brent crude rose more than 2% to touch $114.29 a barrel.

stories.title: BSE IT index heads for its second sharpest month in two decades
stories.summary: The BSE IT index had rallied 14.8% in October by Friday, on track for its second sharpest monthly gain in 20 years of data, behind July 2020's 22.6%. Investors expect gradual growth improvement in FY28. The sector everyone worried about had a good month.

stories.title: Bank of Baroda's profit rises 36% to Rs 6,532 crore
stories.summary: Bank of Baroda's standalone net profit rose 35.81% to Rs 6,531.54 crore in the September quarter, driven by higher other income, core earnings and better asset quality. Net interest income rose 8.98% to Rs 13,026.27 crore and advances grew 18.49%.

stories.title: Muthoot Finance profit jumps 36% as gold loans swell
stories.summary: Muthoot Finance's consolidated Q2 profit rose 36% to Rs 3,278 crore and consolidated AUM grew 42% to Rs 2.09 lakh crore, of which gold loans were Rs 1.93 lakh crore. Its standalone gross NPA ratio rose to 3.87% from 2.28% three months earlier.

stories.title: CDSL profit rises 24% as it opens 75 lakh demat accounts
stories.summary: CDSL's Q2 net profit rose 24% to Rs 173 crore and revenue 23.7% to Rs 395 crore, with EBITDA margin at 58%. It opened about 75 lakh new demat accounts in the quarter, taking assets under custody beyond Rs 89 lakh crore.

stories.title: NTPC profit rises 14% and it declares a Rs 3 dividend
stories.summary: NTPC's standalone Q2 profit rose 14% to Rs 5,320 crore as revenue climbed 16.8% to Rs 45,752 crore and EBITDA 8.7% to Rs 10,891 crore. The board approved a first interim dividend of Rs 3 a share, with 6 November as record date.

stories.title: Godrej Consumer slides 7% despite a 14% profit rise
stories.summary: Godrej Consumer Products shares fell to an intraday low of Rs 777.20 on the NSE after Q2 results, even though net profit rose nearly 14% on volume growth. Brokerages said inflation remains a drag and margin pressure is likely to persist. Profit up, shares down.

stories.title: Kotak rallies nearly 7% and Equitas plunges 28% in BFSI week
stories.summary: In the week of 26 to 30 October, the Nifty gained 2% and Nifty Bank 0.74%. Kotak Mahindra Bank rose nearly 7% after a 29% rise in standalone Q2 profit to Rs 4,212 crore, while Equitas fell 28%.

stories.title: Equitas SFB falls 27% in two days after its CEO exits
stories.summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares fell another 17% on Friday to below Rs 50, a two-day fall of over 27%, after the sudden exit of its CEO and MD overshadowed strong operating results. Analysts said succession uncertainty could keep the stock under pressure.

stories.title: Laurus Labs rallies 19% in four days to a new high
stories.summary: Laurus Labs shares hit a new high of Rs 2,338.90 on the NSE after strong September-quarter results, rising for a fourth straight day and 19% in that stretch. The stock is 154% above its 52-week low of Rs 917.95 from February.

stories.title: Fund managers expect a cautious November for Indian debt
stories.summary: Six fixed-income managers told Cafemutual that rising crude prices, higher global bond yields and tighter banking liquidity will keep Indian debt markets cautious in November. They also said rising yields are opening opportunities for investors with the right horizon.

stories.title: AI spending fears trigger a Wall Street tech sell-off
stories.summary: Technology stocks sold off on Wall Street this week as investors worried AI infrastructure spending may not turn into profits quickly enough to justify valuations. Earnings showed continued cloud and AI growth, but investors focused on the cost of data centres and chips.

stories.title: S&P turns Meta's credit outlook negative over AI spending
stories.summary: S&P Global Ratings changed the outlook on Meta's AA- credit rating to negative, citing balance sheet strain from AI spending and rising leverage. S&P said Meta's ability to monetise its AI investments is more limited than its peers'. The rating itself stays AA-.

stories.title: US Treasury yields post their biggest monthly fall since 2023
stories.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield fell 36 basis points in October, the most since December 2023, and declined for a fourth straight week. The Nasdaq fell more than 2% after Amazon and Intel results unsettled investors already worried about AI buildout costs.

stories.title: The Dow heads for its biggest monthly lead over the Nasdaq since 2022
stories.summary: With a day left in October, the Nasdaq Composite was down about 2.5% and the S&P 500 communication-services sector had fallen over 14%, MarketWatch reports. Energy stocks gained nearly 12% and financials almost 10%. The old economy had the better month.

stories.title: Wall Street's favourite stocks trail its least favourite
stories.summary: S&P 500 stocks with the most analyst Buy ratings have trailed those with the fewest for most of 2026, Piper Sandler's Michael Kantrowitz said, the third-worst stretch in data back to 1995. Analysts piled Buy ratings onto the AI build-out. The ignored stocks did better.

stories.title: Two Fed officials say the hiking cycle is not over
stories.summary: Two days after the Fed held rates, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said the FOMC needs at least two more 25 basis point increases. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said further firming would be necessary, and soon.

stories.title: Carlyle and KKR line up to buy bargain US loans
stories.summary: Carlyle, KKR and Oaktree are among managers considering buying US leveraged loans trading at bargain prices to package into CLOs, Bloomberg reports. Fund managers have set up about 286 warehouse lines to buy loans for CLOs, Barclays strategists said.

stories.title: Silver has lost more than half its value since February
stories.summary: Silver slipped to $50 an ounce this week, down more than 58% from its February high, as profit-booking, slower industrial demand growth and changing macroeconomic conditions weighed. Long-term demand from renewables and electronics remains supportive, the report says.

stories.title: Raw sugar gains nearly 10% in October as robusta falls 6%
stories.summary: Raw sugar futures gained 9.8% in October on concerns that too much rain hurt production in Brazil, though they slipped on Friday to 19.36 cents per lb as the Brazilian real weakened. Robusta coffee fell 6% over the month, Reuters reports.

stories.title: IMF says the RBI should let the rupee move freely
stories.summary: The IMF said weather events, including a super El Nino, remain a downside risk to India's growth, which it had projected at 7% for FY27 and FY28. It said the rupee should be the first line of defence against the ongoing energy shocks.

stories.title: SEBI to release an FII compliance paper within weeks
stories.summary: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said a consultation paper on aligning foreign investor norms with global standards will be out within weeks. FIIs have withdrawn a net $31.4 billion from Indian equities this year, chasing safe-haven assets as US yields rose.

stories.title: SEBI eases KYC review periods for foreign investors
stories.summary: SEBI relaxed KYC review periodicity for FPIs from 1 December, raising it from one year to two years and from three years to eight years. It also cleared IPO drafts from Atomberg Technologies, GNI Infrastructure, Ratnadeep Retail and Punjab Carbonic.

stories.title: SEBI chief on what a Calcutta Stock Exchange revival needs
stories.summary: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said reviving the Calcutta Stock Exchange depends on attracting volumes, a sustainable business model and large technology investment. The rules do not rule out new exchanges, he said, but the market has changed since regional exchanges operated.

stories.title: SEBI is monitoring governance developments at Tata Sons
stories.summary: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said there are some issues at the Tata Sons holding company level, which is not listed, while listed Tata companies follow LODR norms. He said SEBI has to keep monitoring developments but did not identify specific governance concerns.

stories.title: SEBI bars EKI Energy and its MD over misstated accounts
stories.summary: SEBI barred carbon credit trader EKI Energy Services for two months and MD Manish Kumar Dabkara for 12 months for misrepresenting financial statements and diverting funds. The former CFO was barred for eight months, and penalties total Rs 88 lakh.

stories.title: Finance Ministry says IDBI Bank's reserve price was not changed
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry said the reserve price in IDBI Bank's strategic sale was neither cut nor raised. Initial bids in 2025-26 fell short and were rejected, and best-offer sealed bids were later invited. The ministry said the first round lapsed once those initial bids were not approved.

stories.title: Bank credit to services jumps 28.3% in September
stories.summary: Bank credit to services grew 28.3% year on year in September, while industrial and agricultural credit each grew 19.5%, RBI data show. Overall non-food bank credit grew 19.1%, against 11.2% a year earlier.

stories.title: Bank lending surges as corporate bond issuance dries up
stories.summary: Financial resources flowing to the commercial sector rose 55.4% to Rs 17.5 lakh crore in April to August, a Finance Ministry report said. Non-food bank credit rose to Rs 9.8 lakh crore, while corporate bond issues fell to Rs 0.3 lakh crore as yields climbed.

stories.title: Bank of Baroda expects 50 to 75 basis points of RBI hikes
stories.summary: A Bank of Baroda report expects the RBI to raise rates by a cumulative 50 to 75 basis points in this tightening cycle, after its first 25 basis point hike in nearly four years. It cites strong consumption, mixed tax collections and confidence concerns.

stories.title: RBI to trial 200 crore plastic Rs 10 and Rs 20 notes
stories.summary: The RBI plans to introduce 200 crore polymer notes of Rs 10 and Rs 20 for field trials from 1 April 2027, Mint reported, citing a source. The notes keep existing dimensions, so banks will not need to reconfigure ATMs.

stories.title: Salesforce says no vulnerability on its side in AU SFB leak
stories.summary: Salesforce said it has not identified a vulnerability in its platform related to AU Small Finance Bank's potential data leak. A day earlier the bank said it was probing a possible leak of vehicle loan customer data on a SaaS platform hosted by Salesforce.

stories.title: Irdai's commission caps could halve small banks' bancassurance income
stories.summary: Proposed Irdai caps on insurance distribution commissions could erode more than half the bancassurance income at some small and mid-sized lenders, with losses up to 70% in some products, Mint reports. The 23 September paper also bars making insurance compulsory with loans.

stories.title: CCI clears five deals, including Sapphire and Devyani merger
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India approved five transactions across food services, renewable energy, power, financial services and telecom. They include the merger of Sapphire Foods into Devyani International, combining two big KFC and Pizza Hut operators in India.

stories.title: Gold drags India's forex reserves down to $719.75 billion
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell $1.269 billion to $719.748 billion in the week to 23 October, RBI data show, after a $5.011 billion drop the week before. Reserves hit a record $785.706 billion in early September and have declined since.

stories.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of the stolen $6.3 billion
stories.summary: Binance said it has replenished 90% of the assets stolen in its record $6.3 billion hack, buying replacement tokens with its own funds. The remaining 10% are less liquid tokens. Co-CEO Richard Teng said users will not bear the financial impact.

stories.title: OPay's shares fail to start trading after its $304 million IPO
stories.summary: Nigeria-focused fintech OPay's shares failed to begin trading on the NYSE on 30 October, despite raising $304 million at $19 a share in its IPO, valuing it at about $4 billion. The NYSE trading feed showed a halt with news pending.

stories.title: Indian travellers can book Singapore and Dubai attractions with UPI
stories.summary: Indian travellers can now book tickets at Singapore's Resorts World Sentosa through UPI apps, extending a facility already live for At the Top, Burj Khalifa, the Finance Ministry said. The tie-up involves NPCI International Payments, UAE provider NEOPAY and Emaar Entertainment.

stories.title: Government says UPI stays free for consumers
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry said UPI will remain free for consumers and all person-to-person transactions stay free. If merchant discount rate charges come in, they will apply only to a limited set of merchant transactions above a threshold at a nominal rate.

stories.title: UK fintech Lovey secures up to £250 million for SME lending
stories.summary: UK fintech Lovey agreed a senior secured credit facility of up to £250 million with Pollen Street Capital, comprising £50 million committed and a £200 million accordion. It has lent more than £600 million to over 11,000 SMEs since 2016.

stories.title: ZFunds lets distributors offer US stocks and ETFs
stories.summary: B2B wealth platform ZFunds launched access to US stocks and ETFs for mutual fund distributors and wealth managers on 22 October. Unlike DIY apps, distributors onboard clients, guide their international investments and earn brokerage income. The middleman has found a new aisle.

stories.title: Under half of Indian households use digital payments for purchases
stories.summary: An SBI research report found 45.6% of Indian households use digital channels for at least one purchase, while 54.4% still do not. Food makes up about 32.82% of household spending but only 7.10% of digital transactions. Groceries remain loyal to cash.

stories.title: Why India wants an e-rupee when it already has UPI
stories.summary: EdexLive explains the RBI-issued digital rupee, designed to work like physical cash in electronic form. The government is already using it to transfer interest subsidies to eligible students under the PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme. UPI moves bank money. The e-rupee is the money itself.

stories.title: CCI clears Prosus' $100 million investment in Navi
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India approved Prosus' minority stake in Sachin Bansal's fintech Navi, following its $100 million investment, Navi's first institutional fundraise. Bansal said the partnership mattered given his decade-long association with Naspers and Prosus.

stories.title: Visa signs a digital payments pact with Senegal
stories.summary: Visa and Senegal's Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs signed a memorandum of understanding setting up a two-year framework for strategic collaboration to support Senegal's digital transformation ambitions, Finextra reports. The full piece did not load for us.

stories.title: OKX reports $36 billion in onchain assets
stories.summary: Crypto exchange OKX marked four years of its Proof of Reserves programme, reporting $36.36 billion in onchain assets across 22 major cryptocurrencies, Finextra reports. In a week when Binance lost $6.3 billion, showing the reserves is the marketing.

stories.title: Tokenisation platform Assetize gets Jersey registration
stories.summary: Assetize Financial Services (Jersey) Limited, part of the Assetize group, has been registered by the Jersey Financial Services Commission to carry on trust company business, Finextra reports. Tokenisation keeps arriving through the most traditional door available, a trust licence.

stories.title: ACI Worldwide and Circle team up on LatAm stablecoin payments
stories.summary: Payments technology firm ACI Worldwide and USDC issuer Circle Internet Group announced a collaboration focused on stablecoins in Latin American payments, Finextra reports. ACI is listed on Nasdaq and Circle on the NYSE. The full piece did not load for us beyond the announcement.

stories.title: Why your October salary may look smaller
stories.summary: Many salaried employees saw lower take-home pay in October because the mandatory PF wage ceiling rose from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 a month from 17 September, the first revision in 12 years. The CTC did not change. More of it now goes to your future self.

stories.title: EPFO weighs putting 3% of fresh money into AIFs
stories.summary: The EPFO is working on guidelines to invest 3% of its fresh annual investments in alternative investment funds, including startup funds, the Times of India reported. The proposal needs approval from its Central Board of Trustees. The PF has mostly stuck to government securities and debt.

stories.title: SGB 2021-22 Series VII can be redeemed early on 2 November
stories.summary: Holders of Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII can redeem early on 2 November, five years after issue. The RBI has fixed the redemption price at Rs 14,167 per gram, Mint reports, a gain of about 200%.

stories.title: How the 3% DA hike can lift gratuity by nearly Rs 50,000
stories.summary: The Centre raised DA for central government employees and DR for pensioners from 60% to 63%, effective 1 July 2026. Since retirement gratuity is based on basic pay plus DA, the hike can add nearly Rs 50,000 for some employees about to retire, ET calculates.

stories.title: How much of your PF can you actually withdraw
stories.summary: EPFO members can withdraw up to 75% of their provident fund balance, including employer share, while keeping 25% as a minimum buffer, Mint explains. That 75% is what the rules call 100% of eligible funds. Partial withdrawal rules were simplified by merging 13 provisions.

stories.title: US active funds face big capital gains payouts this year
stories.summary: Actively managed US mutual funds are poised to distribute large capital gains as the S&P 500 heads for a fourth year of double-digit gains, CNBC reports. Morningstar's Stephen Welch compiled a list of funds with the highest estimated 2026 distributions.

stories.title: EPFO has not extended the September ECR deadline
stories.summary: The EPFO has not announced any further extension for filing September 2026 ECR returns and depositing PF contributions, ET reports. Employers already had an extension from 15 October to 31 October because of the change in the wage ceiling to Rs 25,000.

stories.title: When you can open an SCSS account at 55
stories.summary: The Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme normally needs investors to be 60, but certain exceptions allow some people to open an account from age 55 if they meet specific conditions, Mint explains. The scheme is government backed and designed for steady retirement income.

stories.title: Pension ministry clarifies UPS contributions during probation and leave
stories.summary: The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare issued office memorandums dated 27 October explaining how Unified Pension Scheme contributions apply to central government employees during probation, suspension, absence from duty and deputation, under the 2025 UPS rules.

stories.title: What happens after the 8th Pay Commission reports
stories.summary: The 8th Pay Commission, a three-member body headed by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, completes a year on 3 November and recently held meetings in Bengaluru and Mumbai. Mint explains the steps between its report and changes to central government salaries and pensions.
